english: Calling upon the assistance of the Holy Trinity, Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, one {OCR?} true God,
we begin to write {OCR?} the Book of the Chronography of Times {OCR?},
composed by Mor Gregory the Maphrian,
the light of the East and of the West,
who is Abu'l-Faraj, son of Aaron the physician, from the city {OCR?} of Melitene,
and is known as {OCR?} Barhebraeus.
First, the preface.
O God, help my weakness.
Blessed are You, O Lord, and Lord of every beginning and ending;
You are the First and You are the Last.
And towards You every course is prepared,
and to You every thanksgiving is owed,
and to the Son, the Word, the power of Your wisdom,
and to the Holy Spirit, the life of Your essence,
from eternity, and now, and forever.
And because this rational animal was created to know righteousness {OCR?} that it might glorify it, and the good that it might find it:
as for the first knowledge, it is enriched by theoretical thoughts;
and as for this second, it profits from practical hearings.
The commemoration of deeds, therefore, good and bad, which have been performed in every generation,
bestows no small profit upon all those who are diligent to acquire the good,
and are careful to hate the evil;
while it incites to imitate {OCR?} the virtues which it enumerates,
and urges to cast away the foul deeds which it recounts.
